sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Live-cell anti-HA surface staining (no permeabilization) confirmed extracellular display of the HA tag (L2). Surface expression was detected but at lower levels than HA-PCDHGA3; cell clustering (adhesion function) was also reduced proportionally to the lower expression level, making it impossible to separate a tag-specific functional effect from the expression-level effect (L3).
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly reports the HA tag cloned after the signal peptide cleavage site of full-length, membrane-anchored PCDHB11, placing the junction at residue 26 (last SP residue, A) / residue 27 (first mature extracellular residue, G). Python confirms: seq[25]='A', seq[26]='G', and the insertion point is 661 residues from the TM boundary (residues 688–711), well above the >=3 residue minimum. L2 confirms surface accessibility by live-cell staining without permeabilization. L3 notes reduced expression and proportionally reduced clustering, but this confounds any tag-specific functional assessment, so validation_level is surface_only rather than surface_and_function. Full-length PCDHB11 with HA tag inserted immediately after the signal peptide cleavage site (residue 26/27 junction), fused to GFP at the C-terminus (HA-PCDHB11-GFP), expressed in K562 cells. L1 explicitly states the HA oligonucleotide was cloned after the signal peptide cleavage site of PCDHB11.

sources.claim: HA-tagged PCDHB11-GFP was constructed by cloning annealed oligonucleotides coding for the HA-tag YPYDVPDYAE (Lifetech, São Paulo, Brasil) after the signal peptide cleavage site of PCDHB11.

literature_notes: The ledger contains three lines (L1, L2, L3), all from the same study (PMC4828864), all describing the same HA-PCDHB11-GFP construct at the same junction (after SP cleavage site, residue 26/27). No other insertion sites are reported in the ledger. No internal loop insertions, no C-terminal extracellular tags, and no transposon/FP-fusion screens are present in the ledger for PCDHB11. L3 reports reduced surface expression and reduced cell clustering relative to HA-PCDHGA3; because the clustering reduction tracks the expression reduction, it cannot be attributed to tag interference per se, so validation_level is surface_only. The GFP fusion is at the intracellular C-terminus (after TM, residues 712–797) and is not a surface tag site; it is not listed in other_positions because the ledger does not report it as a standalone validated intracellular insertion with a residue number.
